$comment: Source of truth for every colour in a Dormotech document. Values audited from the Figma brand guide (canvas 470:507, Palette 1155:12987). Never write a hex in a template or a stylesheet — add it here and regenerate styles/tokens.css.

forest.name: Deep Forest Green
forest.role: anchor: footers, dark cards, headline text

lime.name: Electric Lime
lime.role: the pulse: data, CTAs, highlight callouts, lime footer theme

headerTint.role: light header ground — a ninth value, not one of the eight palette swatches

derived.$comment: Opacity tints of forest green. These are decisions, not accidents — keep them here so a template never invents its own.

usageRule.note: Audit the ratio over the BODY of a page. A footer band is chrome — a full-lime footer is a named theme, not a violation.

themes.$comment: Headers and footers exist as light and dark twins in the Figma library. Pick one per document and hold it.
